## Services

- [AI Workflow Automation for Marketing Teams](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/ai-automation): Lead capture, automated follow-up, voice agents, content engines and reporting built with n8n, Zapier, Make and the OpenAI API.
- [Performance Marketing Tuned to CTR, ROAS and Conversion](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/performance-marketing): Funnel planning, paid campaigns and analytics where budget follows measured results.

- [AI Strategy & Workflow Audits](https://www.mueednazir.site/services/ai-strategy): Workflow audits scored by payback speed, tool selection between n8n, Zapier, Make and custom builds, and a sequenced automation roadmap.

## Blog

- [What is performance marketing? A beginner's guide to paying for results](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/what-is-performance-marketing-beginners-guide): Part 1 of a 10-part series. What performance marketing is, how it differs from brand marketing, the pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPA), the main channels and the loop every campaign runs on.
- [Unit economics for performance marketing: CAC, LTV and break-even CPA](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/performance-marketing-unit-economics-cac-ltv-break-even): Part 2 of 10. How to work out what you can afford to pay for a customer: contribution margin, break-even CPA and ROAS, LTV, CAC payback and the LTV to CAC ratio, with worked numbers.
- [Conversion tracking for performance marketing: pixels, Conversions API, UTMs and GA4](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/conversion-tracking-setup-pixel-capi-utm-ga4): Part 3 of 10. How ad tracking works, why browser pixels miss conversions, what server-side tracking and the Conversions API fix, how to tag links with UTMs, and why Google, Meta and GA4 never agree.
- [Choosing performance marketing channels: capturing demand vs creating it](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/choosing-performance-marketing-channels-intent-vs-demand): Part 4 of 10. How to pick between Google Search, Shopping, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn and marketplaces, the difference between demand capture and demand creation, and how to split a first budget.
- [Google Search ads explained: the auction, Ad Rank, Quality Score and match types](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/google-search-ads-auction-quality-score-explained): Part 5 of 10. How the Google Ads auction decides who shows and what they pay, what Quality Score measures, how keyword match types work today, and how to structure a first search campaign.
- [Meta ads explained: account structure, broad targeting and the learning phase](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/meta-ads-account-structure-learning-phase): Part 6 of 10. How Meta's ad delivery works, how to structure campaigns and ad sets, why broad targeting often beats detailed interests now, what the learning phase is and how to stop resetting it.
- [Ad creative testing: a framework for hooks, angles, formats and creative fatigue](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ad-creative-testing-framework-hooks-angles-fatigue): Part 7 of 10. Why creative is now the biggest lever in paid social, how to separate angles from executions, a simple testing framework, how to read hook and hold rates, and how to spot creative fatigue.
- [Landing pages for paid traffic: message match, speed and conversion rate](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/landing-page-cro-paid-traffic-message-match): Part 8 of 10. Why conversion rate is often the cheapest place to lower CPA, what message match means, how page speed and form length affect results, and a checklist for landing pages that run behind ads.
- [Scaling ad spend: diminishing returns, marginal CPA and bidding strategies](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/scaling-ad-spend-bidding-diminishing-returns): Part 9 of 10. Why CPA rises as you spend more, the difference between average and marginal CPA, how to choose between Maximize conversions, target CPA and target ROAS, and how to scale budgets vertically and horizontally.
- [Incrementality, MMM and MER: measuring what your ads really caused](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/incrementality-testing-mmm-mer-measurement): Part 10 of 10. Why attributed conversions aren't the same as caused conversions, how holdout and geo tests measure incrementality, what marketing mix modelling does, how to use MER, and a weekly operating rhythm that ties the series together.
- [AI marketing automation: a practical guide for small teams (2026)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-marketing-automation-guide-2026): What to automate first, which tools to use, and how to build AI marketing workflows with n8n, Zapier and Make. A practical 2026 guide for small teams.
- [Performance marketing metrics explained: CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS (and how they connect)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/performance-marketing-metrics-ctr-cpa-roas-2026): What CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPA and ROAS measure, the formula for each, how they chain together, and which one to fix first when a campaign underperforms.
- [How to build an AI lead qualification workflow in n8n](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/n8n-ai-lead-qualification-workflow-2026): A step-by-step n8n build that scores inbound leads with an LLM against your ideal customer profile, returns structured JSON, routes hot leads to sales and nurtures the rest.
- [AI voice agents for lead follow-up: what they handle and where they break](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-voice-agents-lead-follow-up-2026): How AI voice agents work for lead capture and follow-up calls, the speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech loop behind them, which calls they handle well, and where a human should take over.
- [How to write a brand voice guide that AI can actually follow](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/brand-voice-guide-ai-can-follow-2026): Most brand voice guides are adjectives a model can't act on. How to write one with rules, banned words, sample sentences and before-and-after rewrites, then test it.
- [A/B testing AI ad copy: how many variations, and how much traffic you need](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ab-testing-ai-ad-copy-sample-size-2026): AI can write 50 ad variations in a minute, but your traffic can only test a few. How to calculate sample size, pick variations worth testing, and avoid false winners.
- [n8n vs Zapier vs Make in 2026: which automation tool should marketers choose?](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make-marketing): A side-by-side comparison of n8n, Zapier and Make for marketing automation in 2026, covering pricing, AI support, complexity, and when each is the right choice.
- [AI copywriting in 2026: where it works, where it fails, and how to keep brand voice](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-copywriting-where-it-works-2026): AI copywriting is great at first drafts and variations, weak at persuasion and brand voice. How to run an AI assisted copy workflow that converts.
- [How to optimize your website for AI search (GEO): a 2026 playbook](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/optimize-website-for-ai-search-geo-2026): GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) done right: citable passages, brand mentions, freshness and schema. How AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity choose sources.
- [What is AI automation and performance marketing? (definition and how it works)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/what-is-ai-automation-performance-marketing): A plain-language definition of AI automation and performance marketing: what it is, how the two halves combine, and what results teams can expect in 2026.
- [RAG for marketing: put AI to work on your own data (2026)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/rag-for-marketing-2026): A plain-language guide to RAG for marketing teams: what retrieval-augmented generation is, where it beats plain prompts, and how to build a grounded pipeline over your own brand docs and data.
- [AI agents vs workflows for marketing: when to use each (2026)](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-agents-vs-workflows-marketing): Workflows are predictable, agents are autonomous. How to tell which your marketing task needs, the cost and control tradeoff, and how to add agents without losing your grip.
- [How an AI assisted editorial engine cuts revision cycles by 25%](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-editorial-engine-revision-cycles-2026): A three-stage editorial pipeline using AI for research and drafting, with a human editor in control. Real results: 25% fewer revision cycles and higher engagement on client content.
- [OpenAI API vs n8n AI nodes: which should you use?](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/openai-api-vs-n8n-ai-nodes-2026): The difference between calling the OpenAI API directly and using n8n's built-in AI nodes. When each makes sense, with practical examples for marketing workflows.
- [How to audit your marketing workflow for AI automation](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/audit-marketing-workflow-ai-automation-2026): A step-by-step framework for finding the places with the biggest payoff to add AI automation to your marketing workflow. Based on real client audits.
- [n8n for beginners: your first AI marketing automation in 30 minutes](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/n8n-beginners-first-ai-automation-30-minutes-2026): A step-by-step guide to building your first AI powered marketing automation in n8n. From zero to a working workflow in 30 minutes, no coding required.
- [5 marketing tasks you should automate with AI this week](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/5-marketing-tasks-automate-ai-this-week-2026): Five high-impact marketing tasks you can automate with AI tools right now. Each one takes under an hour to set up and saves hours every week.
- [How I built a daily job application pipeline with AI](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/how-i-built-daily-job-application-pipeline-ai-2026): A deep dive into JobTailor: an open-source AI pipeline that scrapes 8+ job boards, tailors a resume per job using LLMs, compiles PDFs, and opens applications every morning at 7am.
- [AI for real estate marketing: how we redesigned Alif Realty](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/ai-real-estate-marketing-alif-realty-redesign-2026): How the team at Anarchy Labs redesigned a luxury real estate website with Next.js, IDX Broker API integration, admin portal, and AI-friendly architecture.
- [Review collection at scale: how QR codes + AI drive customer ratings](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/review-collection-qr-codes-ai-customer-ratings-2026): How Starboard uses QR code scanning, multiplatform routing, and AI drafted reviews to help Indian businesses collect more customer reviews with less friction.
- [Will AI replace marketers? What actually changes in 2026](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/will-ai-replace-marketers-what-changes-2026): An honest look at what AI is doing to marketing roles in 2026. What changes, what stays, and where the real opportunities are.
- [What I've learned about AI content after 6 months](https://www.mueednazir.site/blog/honest-truth-ai-content-six-months-2026): What works with AI content, what does not, and the lessons I have learned building and publishing AI assisted content for clients and my own site.

## Key facts

- Mueed Nazir Bhat is an AI automation and performance marketing specialist from Srinagar, India, currently building the AI automation behind growth work at Anarchy Labs.
- He combines a 3+ year marketing and copywriting background with AI automation using LLMs, n8n, Zapier and Make.
- He designs end-to-end marketing automations from lead capture to follow-up, and builds funnels and paid campaigns tuned to CTR, ROAS and conversion.
- Recent AI-assisted client campaigns lifted brand visibility by 35% and engagement by 28%; automated content workflows cut production time and revision cycles by 25%.
- He has an M.Com from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, and a B.Com from the University of Delhi.
- He is Software Developer & AI Automation Specialist at Anarchy Labs (https://www.anarchylabs.in/team/mueed-nazir-bhat) since 2025, and was Marketing Strategist & Copywriter at Sadat Paints & Plastics Pvt. Ltd. from Feb 2022 to Apr 2026.
